q1Derivation.rule: Owner Clarification Q1: obligations are served in ascending selectionIndex order; reserves are assigned in ascending frozen rank order
q1Derivation.derivationNote: the two CURRENT_ACQUISITION_FAILURE slots were taken from the recomputed status map. planPendingReplacementObligations was NOT used as the ordering authority; it was used only to derive the reserve POSITIONS once the order was fixed

previousQ1IsNotCarriedForward.whyItIsStale: slot 63 closed successfully in Window 05 with reserve 22, and slot 65 newly failed. Replaying the old queue would spend a reserve on a slot that owes nothing and would leave slot 65 unserved

q1Derivation.whyNoSlot59Obligation: P:59 has not been adjudicated unsuccessful. An obligation carries a Q3 reason, and creating one would decide the question the bound owner decision deliberately leaves open

theOrderingCounterfactualIsRefused.counterfactual: if P:59 later fails, 59 < 64, so it should be queued ahead of 64 now
theOrderingCounterfactualIsRefused.why: Q1 sorts ACTUAL obligations. P:59 holds none, so there is nothing to sort. If it later receives a failure adjudication its obligation enters Q1 at that future planning point, and reserves 24 and 25 - already consumed by then - are not retroactively reordered or revoked

notConsulted: how many times a slot has already been replaced

reserveAssignmentDerivation.everyPositionPreviouslyUnassigned: ledger entry k consumes position k for k in 0..23; positions 24 and 25 appear in no committed entry
reserveAssignmentDerivation.positionsAreIndependentOfIdentity: the positions were assigned before any reserve draw entry was read. Only after they were fixed were draw.reserve[24] and draw.reserve[25] looked up, mechanically
reserveAssignmentDerivation.reserve26IsNotAssignedHere: position 26 stays UNASSIGNED. It is not held in reserve for a failure this window might produce - a live failure creates an obligation for a LATER planning point, never a second reserve inside the same window

selectedOption.derivation: two determinate obligations exist, so they take positions 1 and 2 in ascending selectionIndex order; the remaining three positions are filled with the next never-started primaries in ascending order from 66, skipping nothing
selectedOption.whyThreePrimariesRatherThanFewer: the window size is exactly 5 whenever at least five executable work items remain, and 2 obligations plus 44 never-started primaries leaves far more than five
selectedOption.eachPrimarySlotWasCheckedUnreplaced: the current occupant was evaluated for 66, 67 and 68; every one is ORIGINAL_SELECTION and NEVER_STARTED, so none has been replaced and none is a disguised repeat
selectedOption.slot64IsOnItsSecondOccupant: slot 64's chain is ORIGINAL_SELECTION then RESERVE_REPLACEMENT at position 23. Reserve 24 is therefore its SECOND replacement, and replacesOccupant is RESERVE_REPLACEMENT - not ORIGINAL_SELECTION
selectedOption.slot65IsOnItsFirst: slot 65 appears in no committed ledger entry, so its occupant is ORIGINAL_SELECTION and reserve 25 is its first replacement

candidateWindow.everyDrawEntrySha256RecomputedHere: each digest was recomputed with the landed drawEntrySha256 over the frozen draw bytes, not copied from the owner task text and not copied from any earlier record
candidateWindow.splitsAreTheSELECTIONSLOTSSplits: a replacement inherits the SELECTION SLOT's split, never a split of its own. Reserve entries carry no split in the frozen draw

negativeProbes.purpose: each probe constructs a WRONG strategy variant and requires either the landed adapter or the independent current-state governance check to REFUSE it. Adapter acceptance alone is never sufficient authority

twoLayerModel.layer1: the landed windowSpecFromAcquisitionWindowStrategy adapter - structure, digests, splits, reserve ordering, ledger binding, occupant kind, and internal consistency with the strategy’s OWN declared state
twoLayerModel.layer2: an INDEPENDENT current-state governance check, run here, whose only inputs are the independently derived ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL / CURRENT_ACQUISITION_FAILURE / PENDING_CAPABILITY_REVIEW / NEVER_STARTED sets and the committed ledger
twoLayerModel.whyLayer2Exists: the adapter has no access to acquisition outcomes, so it cannot tell whether the state a strategy DECLARES is the state that actually holds. Layer 2 is the only layer that can

probes.name: SUCCESSFUL_SLOT_RESERVED_WITH_CORRECT_DIGESTS
probes.variant: slot 63 - adjudicated ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL in Window 05 - is served as R:63:24 with the CORRECT reserve-24 draw-entry digest, slot 63’s own split, correct monotonic reserve ordering, the ledger-derived occupant kind, and the strategy’s own declared state edited so every internal consistency check still passes
probes.mustRefuseBecause: slot 63 is ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL in the independently derived state. It owes nothing, and re-serving it would spend a reserve on a closed slot and discard a good acquisition of record
probes.expectedAdapterBehaviour: ACCEPT - this is the recorded adapter limitation, not a defect introduced here
probes.whyThisProbeMatters: it is constructed so that NO digest, split, ordering or ledger-binding check at layer 1 can catch it: the reserve-24 digest is byte-correct, the split is slot 63’s own from the frozen draw, the reserve ordering is monotonic, the occupant kind is the one the ledger derives, and the strategy’s OWN declared state was edited so every internal consistency check still passes. If the refusal happens, it is demonstrably a CURRENT-STATE refusal
probes.measuredGovernanceMessage: declared CURRENT_ACQUISITION_FAILURE [63,65] != independently derived [64,65] | R:63:24: slot 63 holds no current obligation in the derived state (it is ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL or pending) | replacement order [63,65] != Q1 ascending obligations [64,65] | R:63:24: not the planner's assignment at replacement 0 (expected slot 64 / reserve 24)

probes.name: FORGED_SUCCESS_COUNT
probes.variant: ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL is overstated to 96, with every other field left internally consistent
probes.mustRefuseBecause: the declared count must equal the independently derived count of 63
probes.expectedAdapterBehaviour: ACCEPT - at a 24-entry ledger P6 is NOT_TRIGGERED for any value at or above 50, so P6 consistency cannot detect an overstatement above the floor. Landed limitation

probes.name: WRONG_Q1_ORDER
probes.variant: the two replacements are served 65 then 64, so slot 65 takes reserve 24 and slot 64 takes reserve 25
probes.mustRefuseBecause: Q1 orders obligations by ascending selectionIndex and assigns reserves monotonically, so 64 must be served first and must take reserve 24
probes.measuredAdapterMessage: the acquisition-window strategy cannot bind a spec: R:65:24: not the planner's slot/reserve assignment at replacement 0
probes.measuredGovernanceMessage: declared CURRENT_ACQUISITION_FAILURE [65,64] != independently derived [64,65] | replacement order [65,64] != Q1 ascending obligations [64,65] | R:65:24: not the planner's assignment at replacement 0 (expected slot 64 / reserve 24) | R:64:25: not the planner's assignment at replacement 1 (expected slot 65 / reserve 25)

probes.name: WRONG_CURRENT_OCCUPANT
probes.variant: R:64:24 claims replacesOccupant ORIGINAL_SELECTION, although slot 64 already holds reserve 23
probes.mustRefuseBecause: slot 64 carries ledger entry 23, so its current occupant is RESERVE_REPLACEMENT and reserve 24 is its SECOND replacement
probes.measuredAdapterMessage: the acquisition-window strategy cannot bind a spec: R:64:24: claimed occupant kind is not the ledger's (RESERVE_REPLACEMENT)
probes.measuredGovernanceMessage: R:64:24: declared replacesOccupant ORIGINAL_SELECTION != ledger-derived RESERVE_REPLACEMENT

probes.name: P59_INSERTED
probes.variant: P:59 replaces P:66 as the first primary
probes.mustRefuseBecause: primaries must be the next never-started slots from index 66; slot 59 is under capability review and is not never-started
probes.measuredAdapterMessage: the acquisition-window strategy cannot bind a spec: P:59: primaries must be the next never-started slots in frozen order
probes.measuredGovernanceMessage: P:59: slot 59 is not an actual current NEVER_STARTED slot | primary indices [59,67,68] are not the next never-started slots [66,67,68]

probes.name: R25_BEFORE_R24
probes.variant: the order stays 64 then 65 but the reserve positions are exchanged, so slot 64 claims reserve 25 and slot 65 claims reserve 24
probes.mustRefuseBecause: the planner's assignment is 64 to 24 and 65 to 25; nothing else binds
probes.measuredAdapterMessage: the acquisition-window strategy cannot bind a spec: R:64:25: not the planner's slot/reserve assignment at replacement 0
probes.measuredGovernanceMessage: R:64:25: not the planner's assignment at replacement 0 (expected slot 64 / reserve 24) | R:65:24: not the planner's assignment at replacement 1 (expected slot 65 / reserve 25)

probes.name: P69_INSTEAD_OF_P66
probes.variant: the primaries are P:69, P:67, P:68 - a never-started slot, but not the NEXT one
probes.mustRefuseBecause: primaries must be CONTIGUOUS from nextNeverStartedSelectionIndex = 66 in frozen order, so skipping 66 is refused even though 69 is itself never-started
probes.measuredAdapterMessage: the acquisition-window strategy cannot bind a spec: P:69: primaries must be the next never-started slots in frozen order
probes.measuredGovernanceMessage: primary indices [69,67,68] are not the next never-started slots [66,67,68]
